plan_item: 77.44.7.B — native pointer selection across Rich Text list items
finding: Native Chromium mouse selection had been verified across paragraphs, while list-item offset coverage used a programmatically constructed Range. That left the browser selection path through nested LI elements unverified.
change: The existing mobile/desktop multi-block Rich Text browser lifecycle now includes two adjacent list items and performs a real mouse drag from inside the first item into the second.

The test verifies the browser's native Selection text, its canonical single-list-block Page Model offsets (without the visual LI separator), underline formatting and selection restoration, Canvas parity, draft Save, separate Publish, and published renderer output.
No runtime source, schema, dependency, production configuration, or production data changed.
